title: Behavior Cloning Under PD Control: A Finite-Horizon Theory of Gain-Dependent Error Amplification
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) on position-controlled robots is shaped by the PD loop that executes policy actions. We give a finite-horizon, nonasymptotic analysis of how controller gains affect BC failure. Independent sub-Gaussian action errors propagate through gain-dependent closed-loop dynamics into sub-Gaussian position errors. The resulting failure tail is controlled by controller amplification multiplied by validation loss and generalization slack, so validation loss alone can mis-rank gains.
